units: <cite ref="Pesachim 85b:12">Pes. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ איגרא</he> the roof burst, v. <cite ref="G00431"><he>זֵיתָא</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 20b:3">B. Mets. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ ארזא וכ׳</he> the cedar pillar of the school was cracked, v. <cite ref="L00714"><he>לָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33b:5">Ab. Zar. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּקְעוּ</he> they (the vessels) burst.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:11">Ib. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּקְעָא עינא</he> her eye burst (fell out).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:1:2">Y. M. Kat. I, beg. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>דלא יִפְקְעָן וכ׳</he> lest the grain burst (sprout) and go to ruin.—

<cite ref="Chullin 89b:6">Ḥull. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ ליה איסור גיד מיניה</he> has the prohibition resting on the nervus ischiadicus gone from it (ceased to affect it)? <cite ref="Chullin 139a:8">Ib. 139ᵃ</cite> <he>פַּקְעָה קדושתייהו מינייהו</he> their sacred character has ceased; Y. Keth. VIII, 22ᵇ top <he>פַּקְעַת מינייהו קדושתן</he>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Gittin 44a:15">Gitt. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>מְפַקַּע ליה ממצות</he> (by leaving his slave in the hands of a gentile) he prevents him from living up to the obligations (resting on the Noachidæ, v. <cite ref="N00468"><he>נֹחַ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bekhorot 3a">Bekh. 3ᵃ</cite>

senses.gloss: as preced. Hif., to cancel, cause a release.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 48b:16">Shebu. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>אתיא שביעית אַפְקַעְתֵּיה</he> the Sabbatical year comes and causes the cancellation of the debt.
<cite ref="Gittin 36b:8">Gitt. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>אלימי לאַפְקוּעֵי ממונא</he> they have the power to declare a debt cancelled.

<cite ref="Ketubot 3a">Keth. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל דמקדש … ואַפְקְעִינְהוּ רבנן וכ׳</he> whoever betroths a woman, does so in the sense of the rabbinical law (v. <cite ref="D00951"><he>דַּעְתָּא</he></cite>), and for an eventuality like this the Rabbis have annulled his betrothal retroactively (so that no divorce would be necessary at all); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to let go forth, issue, make known.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 36a:10">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>בקיאין סימנייהו</he> their pictorial signatures on documents are well known) <he>מעיקרא במאי אַפְקְעִינְהוּ</he> on what kind of writs did they originally issue their signatures (so as to make the public familiar with them)?, v. <cite ref="Q01489"><he>פְּקִיעַ</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: to be broken into. Targ. II Esth. III, 7 (ref. to ותבקע, II Kings XXV, 4).
